proposals.title: Rotondo fra le radici
proposals.design: Design A: a surprisingly round, broad-backed animal, low small pointed face and stubby paws, huge rounded chestnut-walnut horny scales overlapping asymmetrically like natural armor shingles. Cream underside clearly visible near the chin and between its front legs. It is sniffing a thin exposed root with one front paw gently raised; all four paws identifiable. Tail bends naturally toward the viewer. Not fluffy, no mammalian fur mane.
proposals.scene: A verdant ancient woodland floor with gnarled mossy roots, little unfurling fern shoots and soft lichen. Ground-level three-quarter side view, animal on the RIGHT, turned gently toward the left. Layered dark green woodland depth across the quiet middle, diffuse cool forest light, earthy walnut and sage-green palette.

proposals.title: Lungo presso il ruscello
proposals.design: Design B: distinctly long and very low to the ground, slender pointed muzzle and long tapered tail, narrower shoulders than hips; a sequence of many narrow transverse flexible brown tobacco/caramel horny bands across its armor, with small darker overlapping plates along the flanks. Short claws broad enough to grip wet soil. Dynamic cautious trot, all FOURpaws in a clear gait, not rolling into a ball, not a crocodile.
proposals.scene: A green willow-lined shallow stream with smooth wet pebbles, bright leaf-green reeds and small overhanging ferns, no flower fairies. Animal on the LEFT along the bank, facing right, seen in side three-quarter profile. Muted teal-green water gently crosses the lower scene while the middle band remains softly reflected and clear. Cooler diffuse morning-like ambient light without showing any celestial object; tobacco and caramel browns contrast with willow green.

proposals.title: Dorso alto nella felceta
proposals.design: Design C: tall domed but angular carapace, short stocky legs and an unusually delicate long pointed face peeking beneath its broad brow; broad angular walnut-grey and umber horny plates with beveled organic ridges and flexible seams. Stout short tapering tail, TWOdark eyes and round restrained ears. Prudently lowers the snout and braces its four claws at a fern clearing edge, partly drawing shoulders inward but NOT fully curled, every paw remains visible. Not a hedgehog: no spines.

Animal on the RIGHT, body diagonally oriented toward the lower left. Make the surrounding leaves larger than the70cm animal to establish small scale. Dusky blue-green forest depth across the quiet middle; grey-brown/umber armor and warm cream underside.
